text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官。

text_en: In you, O Lord , I seek refuge; do not let me ever be put to shame; in your righteousness deliver me.
text_cn: 上主，我投靠你，总不会受辱， 求你凭你的公义将我救出；

text_en: Incline your ear to me; rescue me speedily. Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to save me.
text_cn: 求你侧你的耳听我，速来救我： 作我避难的磐石，获救的城堡。

text_en: You are indeed my rock and my fortress; for your name’s sake lead me and guide me,
text_cn: 因为你是我的磐石，我的城堡， 为你的名，求你引导我指教我。

text_en: take me out of the net that is hidden for me, for you are my refuge.
text_cn: 求你救我脱免暗布的网罗， 因为唯有你是我的避难所。

text_en: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O Lord , faithful God.
text_cn: 我将我的灵魂托于你的掌握， 上主，忠实的天主，你必拯救我。

text_en: You hate those who pay regard to worthless idols, but I trust in the Lord .
text_cn: 拜虚无偶像的人，你深恶痛绝。 上主，然而我却对你全心信赖。

text_en: I will exult and rejoice in your steadfast love, because you have seen my affliction; you have taken heed of my adversities,
text_cn: 我要因你的慈爱喜乐欢畅， 因为你曾俯视了我的惨状， 体会了我心灵所受的悲伤；

text_en: and have not delivered me into the hand of the enemy; you have set my feet in a broad place.
text_cn: 你没有将我交于仇敌之手， 反而使我稳立于广阔之处。

text_en: Be gracious to me, O Lord , for I am in distress; my eye wastes away from grief, my soul and body also.
text_cn: 上主，求你可怜我，因为我陷入困苦状况， 我的眼睛、心灵和肺腑，全因忧伤而颓丧。

text_en: For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my misery, and my bones waste away.
text_cn: 我的生命因忧伤而耗尽，我的岁月在涕泣中消逝， 我的精力因悲伤而衰退，我的骸骨也已枯槁腐蚀。

text_en: I am the scorn of all my adversaries, a horror to my neighbors, an object of dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.
text_cn: 我的仇敌都辱骂我，我的四邻都耻笑我， 我的知己憎恨我，路上的行人都远避我。

text_en: I have passed out of mind like one who is dead; I have become like a broken vessel.
text_cn: 我被人全心忘掉，有如死人， 活像一个破旧抛弃的瓦盆。

text_en: For I hear the whispering of many— terror all around! — as they scheme together against me, as they plot to take my life.
text_cn: 当我听到许多人在呼啸，恐怖弥漫四境， 他们在群集商议攻击我，谋夺我的性命；

text_en: But I trust in you, O Lord ; I say, “You are my God. ”
text_cn: 我仍旧依靠你，上主， 我说：“你是我的天主！”

text_en: My times are in your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and persecutors.
text_cn: 我的命运全掌握于你手， 求你救我脱离我的敌手， 摆脱一切迫害我的仇雠（chóu）。

text_en: Let your face shine upon your servant; save me in your steadfast love.
text_cn: 求以你的慈容，光照你仆， 求以你的仁慈把我救出。

text_en: Do not let me be put to shame, O Lord , for I call on you; let the wicked be put to shame; let them go dumbfounded to Sheol.
text_cn: 上主，因为我呼号了你，求你莫让我蒙羞； 愿恶人备受耻辱，默默然归入阴府！

text_en: Let the lying lips be stilled that speak insolently against the righteous with pride and contempt.
text_cn: 愿那些骄傲自大，口出妄言， 说谎攻击义人的唇舌哑喑（yīn）！

text_en: O how abundant is your goodness that you have laid up for those who fear you, and accomplished for those who take refuge in you, in the sight of everyone!
text_cn: 上主，你为敬畏你的人所保留的恩泽，是何等丰盛！ 你在人前施予投奔于你者的慈惠，又是何等宽宏！

text_en: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from human plots; you hold them safe under your shelter from contentious tongues.
text_cn: 你将他们掩护在你仪容的影下，免遭世人的重创； 又将他们隐藏在你帐幕的里面，免遭口舌的中伤。

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , for he has wondrously shown his steadfast love to me when I was beset as a city under siege.
text_cn: 愿上主受赞美，因为他在坚固的城内， 向我特别显出他那奇妙无比的慈爱，

text_en: I had said in my alarm, “I am driven far from your sight. ” But you heard my supplications when I cried out to you for help.
text_cn: 我虽在惶恐中曾说：“我已被驱逐离开你前。” 但我一呼求你，你即刻俯允我的呼声哀叹。

text_en: Love the Lord , all you his saints. The Lord preserves the faithful, but abundantly repays the one who acts haughtily.
text_cn: 众圣徒！你们应爱慕上主，因他保佑信徒， 但是他对蛮横的人，必加以严厉的报复。

text_en: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the Lord .
text_cn: 凡一切信赖上主的人们， 请勇敢鼓起你们的心神。
